leading_hypotheses.claim: CAS abort on empty lot + Manage Worlds churn leaves Live/Build camera+world lighting in a void where only the lot platform hover wireframe remains interactive until Build↔Live reset or process restart.
leading_hypotheses.falsifier: Reproduce CAS abort then PrintWindow/desktop stay CONTENT_PRESENT without recovery.

leading_hypotheses.claim: Mouse-tracking lot platform in a black void means the session is NOT hung; host should run the camera/Build↔Live ladder before reboot, then AUTHORIZED_GAME_RESTART if still anomalous.
leading_hypotheses.falsifier: Mouse moves but no platform motion and no recovery path ever restores CONTENT_PRESENT without restart.

leading_hypotheses.claim: Night empty lot without lights yields VIEWPORT_BLACK_HUD_ALIVE (world dark, HUD lit) and is avoidable with lights or Build-mode camera.
leading_hypotheses.falsifier: Night empty lot PrintWindow shows CONTENT_PRESENT in world region without lights.

leading_hypotheses.claim: Desktop/computer-use capture overlays aggravate focus/render instability and miss secondary-monitor Sims; PrintWindow-only observation is required for host decisions.
leading_hypotheses.falsifier: Repeated computer-use captures never correlate with iconic/black transitions on this patch.

not_claimed: That every black screen requires reboot
That offline heuristics certify Live Mode

avoidance.rule: When needs are critical, prefer Send Alone / keep_home_lot decisions so host retains Bargain Bend control.
Never click empty-lot person/CAS control when intending Play LabLab; require household Play triangle after LabLab tip is visible.
After Manage Worlds, CAS exit, travel, or lot Play: PrintWindow capture + viewport analyze BEFORE needs/object clicks.
Do not use desktop/computer-use screenshots as Sims proof; they conflict with focus. Prefer PrintWindow.
Empty-lot night sessions: place a light or enter Build briefly before trusting Live world clicks.
If Sims is on a secondary monitor, never diagnose from primary desktop/computer-use captures; use PrintWindow on the TS4 HWND (and optional operator sneak of the game display).

recovery_ladder.behavior: Graceful TS4 close then disposable game_host launch; never Resume; never touch user-named saves; lab slot load only with existing save_guard.
recovery_ladder.when: Still FULL_CLIENT_BLACK or VIEWPORT_NEAR_BLACK after camera ladder
